text: July 2025: We cleaned the windows inside and out at a Coolangatta property, including the tracks, screens and low-E glass. The water-marked louvres and dull screens were cleaned up, and the balcony sliding doors finished clear, with sharp reflections and no visible spotting.
alt: Clean sliding glass doors and black balustrade on a sunny balcony, with clear reflections and no visible spotting in Coolangatta
